title: Smoky Shrimp Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry recipe with succulent shrimp, crispy vegetables, and a smoky kick.

ingredients.name: light oil
ingredients.notes: such as vegetable or peanut oil

ingredients.name: stir-fry vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as broccoli, bell peppers, and carrots

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of light oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the stir-fry vegetables and cook for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes, until pink and cooked through.
Add the smoked paprika and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Stir in the soy sauce and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Optional: Garnish with sesame seeds, green onions, or sliced scallions for added flavor and texture.
